claim: Skill security teaching uses a two-layer model: production SKILL.md uses safe wording only; literal bad examples live in skillify/examples/bad/security-wording-anti-patterns.md with aguara-ignore-next-line quarantine per bad line — you can teach the negative rule without weakening CI or tempting naive agents to execute attack-shaped prose in operator-facing files.

decisions.notes: Meta-lesson from PR #222: euphemizing bad patterns in the reference card failed pedagogy; aguara inline-ignore on quarantined curriculum resolves the paradox (like labeled vaccine samples).
